registration_semantics.plan_core_rule: Before registration set status to locked, materialize every fixed field and variant, set design_frozen_at, and hash the plan after excluding only external_registration and locked_at.
registration_semantics.manifest_rule: stage2_design_manifest_v1 binds that plan-core hash and the exact research and input artifacts.
registration_semantics.envelope_rule: After receipt verification and execution authorization, populate external_registration and set locked_at equal to authorized_at. The final envelope is not part of the previously frozen plan-core hash.
registration_semantics.non_circularity_rule: The manifest has no self-hash or later-artifact hash; the receipt points backward to the manifest; the authorization points backward to the manifest, receipt, and plan core; the final plan envelope records their hashes only after authorization.

official_calendar_contract.format: UTF-8 CSV with one date column and one common SSE/SZSE official open session per row
official_calendar_contract.input_hash_rule: official_calendar_sha256 is SHA-256 of the exact input bytes; no normalization after design freeze

ic_outcome_clock.no_lag: adjusted close t to adjusted close t+20 on official exchange sessions
ic_outcome_clock.one_session_lag: adjusted close t+1 to adjusted close t+21 on official exchange sessions

portfolio_module.required_before_claims: separate externally registered and tested execution plan

planned_excluded_modules.shapley_boundary: Exact four-component Shapley allocation preserves interactions but does not implement formal interaction tests.

variants_source: Before design-manifest registration, copy the exact 18 variants from plan.draft.json, freeze their order in the plan core, and do not add, delete, or rename cells after design_frozen_at.
reporting_rule: Report every registered IC cell and exactly 26 inferential estimands (one primary plus 25 secondary family members), with two deterministic timing-isolation checks reported separately; cell-level means, Newey-West t-statistics, and top-minus-universe spreads are descriptive only and cannot support cell-specific discovery claims; do not select or headline a best result.

deviation_reporting_module.current_boundary: The protocol requires manual disclosure, but the current runner and receipt do not create, bind, or verify a structured deviation log.

deviation_rule: Record every deviation without replacing the primary analysis; outcome-aware deviations are exploratory only.
